observations: Manual sewing machine with a black cast-iron head and gold-colored decals.
The brand 'S.BROTHER' is printed in yellow/gold on the arm.
The machine is mounted on a wooden table with a folding leaf and two side drawers.
The assembly includes a cast-iron treadle stand with a foot pedal and a large drive wheel.
A small orange/red dial is visible on the front of the machine head, likely for stitch length adjustment.
The wooden tabletop shows some surface wear and scratches.

response.reason: The item is a standard S.BROTHER manual sewing machine. While its functional state is unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/parts) based on the provided photos.
